<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 650 520" width="650" height="520">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="650" height="520" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Graph Grid & Axes Group -->
  <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">
    <!-- Grid Lines (horizontal) -->
    <!-- y values: 50, 40, 20, 0, -20, -40, -60, -70, -80, -90 -->
    <!-- Corresponding Y pixel coordinates (origin (0,0) at top-left):
         y=50  -> 50
         y=40  -> 70
         y=20  -> 110
         y=0   -> 150
         y=-20 -> 190
         y=-40 -> 230
         y=-60 -> 270
         y=-70 -> 290 (Resting potential level)
         y=-80 -> 310
         y=-90 -> 330
    -->
    
    <!-- Minor horizontal grid lines -->
    <line x1="100" y1="50" x2="550" y2="50" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="100" y1="70" x2="550" y2="70" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="100" y1="110" x2="550" y2="110" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="100" y1="150" x2="550" y2="150" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="100" y1="190" x2="550" y2="190" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="100" y1="230" x2="550" y2="230" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="100" y1="270" x2="550" y2="270" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="100" y1="310" x2="550" y2="310" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="100" y1="330" x2="550" y2="330" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- Grid Lines (vertical) for time: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ms -->
    <!-- X pixel coordinates: 100 + t * 90 -->
    <!-- t=0: 100, t=1: 190, t=2: 280, t=3: 370, t=4: 460, t=5: 550 -->
    <line x1="190" y1="50" x2="190" y2="330" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="280" y1="50" x2="280" y2="330" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="370" y1="50" x2="370" y2="330" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="460" y1="50" x2="460" y2="330" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- Y-Axis Ticks & Labels (-80 to 40 marked every 20, plus +50 and -90) -->
    <!-- +50 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="50" x2="100" y2="50" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="54" text-anchor="end">+50</text>
    
    <!-- +40 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="70" x2="100" y2="70" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="74" text-anchor="end">+40</text>

    <!-- +20 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="110" x2="100" y2="110" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="114" text-anchor="end">+20</text>

    <!-- 0 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="150" x2="100" y2="150" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="154" text-anchor="end">0</text>

    <!-- -20 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="190" x2="100" y2="190" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="194" text-anchor="end">−20</text>

    <!-- -40 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="230" x2="100" y2="230" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="234" text-anchor="end">−40</text>

    <!-- -60 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="270" x2="100" y2="270" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="274" text-anchor="end">−60</text>

    <!-- -80 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="310" x2="100" y2="310" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="314" text-anchor="end">−80</text>

    <!-- -90 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="330" x2="100" y2="330" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="85" y="334" text-anchor="end">−90</text>

    <!-- X-Axis Ticks & Labels (0 to 5) -->
    <!-- 0 -->
    <line x1="100" y1="330" x2="100" y2="335" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="100" y="352" text-anchor="middle">0</text>

    <!-- 1 -->
    <line x1="190" y1="330" x2="190" y2="335" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="190" y="352" text-anchor="middle">1</text>

    <!-- 2 -->
    <line x1="280" y1="330" x2="280" y2="335" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="280" y="352" text-anchor="middle">2</text>

    <!-- 3 -->
    <line x1="370" y1="330" x2="370" y2="335" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="370" y="352" text-anchor="middle">3</text>

    <!-- 4 -->
    <line x1="460" y1="330" x2="460" y2="335" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="460" y="352" text-anchor="middle">4</text>

    <!-- 5 -->
    <line x1="550" y1="330" x2="550" y2="335" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="550" y="352" text-anchor="middle">5</text>

    <!-- Axis Lines -->
    <line x1="100" y1="50" x2="100" y2="330" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="100" y1="330" x2="570" y2="330" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Axis Labels -->
    <text x="325" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14">time / ms</text>
    <text x="35" y="190" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90, 35, 190)" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14">membrane potential / mV</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Threshold Line -->
  <!-- -55 mV -> Y = 290 + (-55 - (-70))/10 * 20 = 290 - 30 = 260 -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#000000">
    <line x1="100" y1="260" x2="550" y2="260" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="5,4" stroke-width="1.2" />
    <text x="555" y="264" text-anchor="start">threshold</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Action Potential Curve -->
  <!-- Resting at -70mV (y=290) from x=100 (t=0) to x=172 (t=0.8) -->
  <!-- Rises sharply to +35mV (y=80) at x=244 (t=1.6) -->
  <!-- Falls quickly to dip at -80mV (y=310) at x=334 (t=2.6) -->
  <!-- Recovers to -70mV (y=290) at x=424 (t=3.6) and stays flat to x=550 (t=5) -->
  <path d="M 100 290 
           C 140 290, 160 290, 172 288
           C 185 260, 205 180, 244 80
           C 260 55, 275 180, 334 310
           C 365 315, 395 295, 424 290
           L 550 290" 
        fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Label Lines and Letters for A, B, C, D -->
  <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic" fill="#000000">
    <!-- A: rising phase (around t=1.2, y=190) -->
    <line x1="225" y1="180" x2="265" y2="130" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="270" y="130" text-anchor="start" font-style="normal">A</text>

    <!-- B: falling phase (around t=2.1, y=180) -->
    <line x1="290" y1="180" x2="330" y2="140" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="335" y="140" text-anchor="start" font-style="normal">B</text>

    <!-- C: dip below rest / hyperpolarization (around t=2.6, y=310) -->
    <line x1="334" y1="310" x2="355" y2="355" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="355" y="370" text-anchor="middle" font-style="normal">C</text>

    <!-- D: flat resting part after recovery (around t=4.5, y=290) -->
    <line x1="480" y1="290" x2="500" y2="245" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="500" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-style="normal">D</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="100" y="415" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">Fig. 9.1</text>

</svg>
